databricks.label: Databricks
databricks.note: Days 1-14 on the Databricks 14-day trial, then Databricks Free Edition

features.title: Scan rush hours with time_bucket
features.summary: Buckets a store day of grocery scans into 30-minute slots aligned to the 07:15 opening, with scan counts and health scores per slot.
features.headline: Busiest slot 12:15 · 6 scans · 13 slots

features.title: One-pass category scorecard with WHERE inside aggregates
features.summary: Grocery category scorecard (Nutri-Score A/B, high-risk additives, organic vs conventional) computed in a single BigQuery pass.
features.headline: Organic scores +32.7 points · 7 categories

features.title: Lane counters with counter_diff
features.summary: Turns reboot-prone cumulative checkout-lane scanner counters into items scanned per lane, skipping resets.
features.headline: 4,964 items · 4 resets handled · naive total 10,443

features.title: Grading grocery predictors with ML.METRICS
features.summary: Scores the organic label as a health predictor and the Nutri-Score letter as a score estimate, with no model, in BigQuery.
features.headline: Organic → healthy F1 0.60 · Nutri-Score R² 0.98

features.title: Barcode audit with a Unity Catalog Python UDF
features.summary: A governed Python UDF (named handler, environment 6) checks every scan's GS1 check digit and counts bad barcodes per checkout lane.
features.headline: 12 of 240 scans invalid · self-checkout 10.9%

new_feature.name: Scalar Unity Catalog Python UDFs with named handlers (GA)

features.title: What moved this week's grocery sales? AI.KEY_DRIVERS
features.summary: Compares this week's units with last week's across every store, category and channel segment in one BigQuery call and finds what drove the change.
features.headline: Units +2.5% · north produce −430 · online bakery +368
